description: The curated ThreatNexus dossier for one threat actor: attribution (with tier, confidence and evidence), ATT&CK techniques, malware, exploited CVEs, campaigns, infrastructure patterns, relationships, GCC/UAE relevance and sources. Choose sections to keep the answer short. "analyst_updates" adds intelligence approved by ThreatNexus analysts since the dossier was written.

actor.description: Actor name, alias or ThreatNexus slug, for example "MuddyWater", "Seedworm" or "muddywater".

sections.description: Sections to include. Default: overview, attribution, ttps, malware, campaigns, sources.

name: get_actor
title: Get a ThreatNexus actor dossier
